怎么用：一般不要直接依赖它；优先用引擎里已封装好该库的上层模块。确需使用时把本模块加进 Build.cs，并包含其第三方头文件。
依赖：在 `YourModule.Build.cs` 加入 `PublicDependencyModuleNames.AddRange(new string[] { "FreeType2" });`；对外暴露 `FreeType2` 类型用 Public，仅内部调用用 Private，然后 Generate Project Files 并编译。
调用：不要 include 引擎模块头去用它；优先用引擎里封装该库的上层模块，仅必要时包含 ThirdParty 目录下的第三方头文件。
en_steps: `FreeType2` (Free Type2): it wraps a third-party library and exposes its functionality to the engine. Located under `ThirdParty`; build rule `ThirdParty/FreeType2/FreeType2.Build.cs`. The descriptor declares no dependencies.
Placement: `FreeType2` is a third-party library wrapper; prefer the engine module that wraps it.
How to use: usually do not depend on it directly; prefer the engine module that already wraps it. If truly needed, add it to Build.cs and include the third-party headers.

Depend: in `YourModule.Build.cs` add `PublicDependencyModuleNames.AddRange(new string[] { "FreeType2" });`. Use Public when exposing `FreeType2` types, Private if only calling it; then Generate Project Files and rebuild.
Call: do not include engine module headers to use it; use the engine module that wraps this library, and only include its ThirdParty headers when truly needed.
note_cn: `FreeType2`：它是对一个第三方库的 UBT 封装，向引擎暴露该库的功能；构建规则 `ThirdParty/FreeType2/FreeType2.Build.cs`，直接依赖 0 个模块。
note_en: `FreeType2`: it wraps a third-party library and exposes its functionality to the engine; build rule `ThirdParty/FreeType2/FreeType2.Build.cs`; depends on 0 modules.

cn_steps: `FriendsAndChat`（Friends And Chat）：它属于 UI 层（Slate/UMG/Widget/Overlay/CommonUI/AppFramework）。位于 `Runtime`，构建规则 `Runtime/FriendsAndChat/FriendsAndChat.Build.cs`。直接依赖 4 个模块：`Core`、`CoreUObject`、`Slate`、`SlateCore`。
部署：`FriendsAndChat` 运行时模块，可进游戏包；只在真正调用其 API 的模块里声明依赖。
怎么用：在 Widget Blueprint 或 Slate C++ 里使用；把它们和 Slate/SlateCore/UMG 一起加入依赖。
依赖：在 `YourModule.Build.cs` 加入 `PublicDependencyModuleNames.AddRange(new string[] { "FriendsAndChat" });`；对外暴露 `FriendsAndChat` 类型用 Public，仅内部调用用 Private，然后 Generate Project Files 并编译。
调用：包含其 `Public/` 头文件以使用导出类型；模块由引擎/插件系统自动加载，通常无需手动 `LoadModulePtr`（仅懒加载时才用 `FModuleManager::LoadModuleChecked`）。
en_steps: `FriendsAndChat` (Friends And Chat): it is part of the UI layer (Slate/UMG/Widget/Overlay/CommonUI/AppFramework). Located under `Runtime`; build rule `Runtime/FriendsAndChat/FriendsAndChat.Build.cs`. It directly depends on 4 modules: `Core`, `CoreUObject`, `Slate`, `SlateCore`.
Placement: `FriendsAndChat` is a runtime module and can ship; depend on it only where you call its API.
How to use: use it from Widget Blueprints or Slate C++; list it alongside Slate/SlateCore/UMG.

Depend: in `YourModule.Build.cs` add `PublicDependencyModuleNames.AddRange(new string[] { "FriendsAndChat" });`. Use Public when exposing `FriendsAndChat` types, Private if only calling it; then Generate Project Files and rebuild.

Call: include its `Public/` headers to use exported types; the engine/plugin system loads the module automatically — no manual `LoadModulePtr` needed (use `FModuleManager::LoadModuleChecked` only for lazy loading).

note_en: `FriendsAndChat`: it is part of the UI layer (Slate/UMG/Widget/Overlay/CommonUI/AppFramework); build rule `Runtime/FriendsAndChat/FriendsAndChat.Build.cs`; depends on 4 modules.
